legend.text:
LEGEND

Orange solid = required slot. Either part of the mission (headline, primary CTA, phone — every hero must have these, like a dungeon must have an exit) or promoted to required by the archetype (e.g. reviews in A7).

Grey dashed = optional slot the generator may include or drop.

Hatched = image.

Shared across all boards: 40px outer margin, 16px slot gap, 12px CTA gap, 56px tall CTAs. Structure only — theme is applied later as a style vector.

p1.text:
A1 SPLIT — params: ratio 50/50 · 60/40 · 40/60 · image side L/R · vertical align · proof under CTA or as strip.
Mobile: stacks. Image above headline if photo is strong, below CTA if weak.

p2.text:
A2 OVERLAY — params: text anchor (bottom-left, centre, left-middle) · scrim strength · height 70–100vh.
Hard constraint: scrim auto-set from image luminance to hit 4.5:1; if it can't, reject this archetype for this image.
Mobile: crop to focal point, text block full width.

p3.text:
A3 STACKED CENTRE — params: centre or left aligned · image as bleed banner, inset or none · headline measure.
Mobile: almost identical — the cheapest collapse of the set.

p4.text:
A4 CARD ON IMAGE — params: card position L/C/R · card surface solid/tint · card overlaps image edge or floats.
Why it exists: contrast is solved by the card, so it tolerates busy photos.
Mobile: card drops below image.

p5.text:
A5 OFFSET — params: overlap 0–25% of headline width · image y-offset · decor block on/off.
Hard constraint: headline never covers the image focal point.
Mobile: overlap removed, becomes A1 stacked.

p6.text:
A6 TYPE-LED — params: display size 72–120px · trust strip on/off · ground tone.
Selected when there's no usable photo — content gates the archetype.
Mobile: headline scales down, CTA + phone stay above the fold.

p7.text:
A7 PROOF-FIRST — params: 1–3 review cards · rating summary top/bottom · team photo on/off.
Gate: only available with real reviews — never generate placeholder proof.
Mobile: rating summary moves under CTA, one review card.

p8.text:
A8 CONTACT PANEL — params: 2–4 fields · panel side L/R · 'or call' line.
Hard constraint: phone stays visible even when a form exists.
Mobile: phone CTA first, form collapses below or behind a button.
